prompt:
Edit sections/podcast-embed.liquid. The {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block at the end must stay byte-for-byte unchanged. It already defines the settings duration_seconds and start_seconds, but the markup currently ignores them. Inputs (all under section.settings, no top-level variables): - section.settings.embed_id: string or null - section.settings.heading: string or null - section.settings.duration_seconds: integer or null (may be 0 or negative) - section.settings.start_seconds: integer or null (may be 0 or negative) Existing behavior to keep: - embed_id is stripped of surrounding whitespace. If it is null or empty after stripping, the section outputs nothing at all. - heading is stripped. The output is
, then

HEADING

only if the stripped heading is non-empty, then , then
. - TITLE is the stripped heading, or Podcast player when the heading is empty or null. - HEADING, TITLE and EMBED_ID are HTML-escaped with the escape filter. - There is no whitespace between any tags. New behavior: 1. Start time. Let start be start_seconds, with null treated as 0. Let duration be duration_seconds, with null treated as 0. - Append ?t=START directly after the escaped embed id in the src only when start > 0 AND (duration <= 0 OR start < duration). - So a start equal to or greater than a positive duration is ignored. When duration is null or <= 0 there is no upper bound. 2. Duration label. When duration > 0, output

Duration: TEXT

immediately after and before . Otherwise output no p element. - If duration < 3600, TEXT is M:SS: total minutes without padding, then seconds padded to 2 digits. Examples: 59 -> 0:59, 60 -> 1:00, 605 -> 10:05, 3599 -> 59:59. - If duration >= 3600, TEXT is H:MM:SS: hours without padding, minutes and seconds each padded to 2 digits. Examples: 3600 -> 1:00:00, 3661 -> 1:01:01, 36000 -> 10:00:00. Use only core Liquid. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/podcast-embed.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
